item.description:
Updates now finish inside Tagify Manager
• Install an update and relaunch directly from the update window. Your setup and settings stay in place. • Skip a version without seeing its startup prompt again. You can still choose Update now later. • If an update cannot be verified or downloaded, the current manager stays available.
• Usage statistics now work automatically without an opt-in step. Previously saved opt-outs stay off; What’s shared? explains the data and includes the off switch.
Managers 1.0.5 and 1.0.6 need one manual replacement to get this update flow.
